Bug_Title: "super.finalize()" should be called at the end of "Object.finalize()" implementations
Bug_Explanation: The finalizer does not call the super.finalize() method, which can lead to memory leakage if the parent class also has a finalizer.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by calling the showBug() method, which in turn calls the finalize() method on an instance of the BuggyFinalize class. This test case is expected to fail because the finalize() method does not call the super.finalize() method, which is a violation of the rule'super.finalize() should be called at the end of Object.finalize() implementations'.
